notes.title: War of Wheels first update!
notes.notes: [p]Hey riders![/p][p]We are happy to announce the first patch for War of Wheels![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/cee459ead6df6c23358735921eb69ae06d82ac4a.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]A huge thank you to all the players who decided to try our game! In recent days we have received invaluable feedback, which we will take into great consideration for future updates.[/p][p]This first patch fixes several bugs and introduces some quality of life features to make driving in the arenas easier and improve vehicle customization. We have also made an initial balancing to increase the combat effectiveness of some weapons, in particular those of the artificer. Finally, a couple of new decorations for your cars.[/p][p][/p][p]You may find all the update informations in the patch changelog.[/p][p][/p][p]We are working hard on the next content, some of which will arrive very soon… we can't wait to show it to you![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2337940/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: New update: News about Aesthetics and Controls
notes.notes:
Greetings to ye, O brave War Riders! We have important news to tell ye regarding the aesthetics of your vehicles and also a new feature requested by ye warriors to have more control over your war chariots.

[list]
[*] News about [b]vehicle aesthetics[/b] and [b]controls customization[/b]!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/ffa45380539208b99a636e41ced9cef1a29d151c.png[/img]

[h2]More and more majestic vehicles: new decorations![/h2]

The most creative of artisans throughout the realm continued to forge fine ornaments, mostly using precious minerals and creating new crystalline shapes that could add further luster to your combat vehicles.

[list]
[*] [b]Visit the Garages[/b] of Zeranthia and adorn your vehicles with [b]exquisite new decorations[/b]!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/771967bc40ce2caede492f55504ac2487f49a946.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/f853a8b5a45945127cf083741937d92ed9ca0179.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/a8ebe939c5955034ee12e188e6ce05717dde0fd0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/c705d35cfddc2aefcec97850b8afc6e36360a484.png[/img]



[h2]Modify the controls according to your will![/h2]

As requested by some of ye, we have introduced the possibility to modify the controls related to vehicle movement and functionality, to provide each rider with greater freedom over the control exercised over their vehicles

[list]
[*] Access the [b]Options[/b] and modify the Game [b]Inputs[/b] to your liking.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485712/ce021ecffb3416e2e5810d75849b36c6dc0d79c4.gif[/img]



[h2]Coming soon: news about Campaign Mode[/h2]

Be prepared for salient news in the near future, we are setting up for ye a new and more elaborate tutorial to introduce ye to the moors of Zeranthia, as well as a new quest system that will allow ye to gradually experience the epic chronicles of the realm

[b][i]Coming soon[/i][/b]: new [b]tutorial[/b], more comprehensive and gradual; 
[b][i]Coming soon[/i][/b]: new [b]quest system[/b], with the addition of a new [b]quest log[/b] and a new [b]quest journal[/b].
